$comment: Every number here was produced by running canonical/tools/a_type_you_wrote_is_a_type_you_guess_v1.py on 2026-12-02 in a 2-CPU sandbox with no network at run time. It is a mechanism measurement over twenty objects and two rooms; it is NOT a benchmark result.

declared_before_the_run.T1_the_written_table_is_right_where_it_h: on the kinds the table names, the table's name is the producer's kind, object for object
declared_before_the_run.T2_the_written_table_collapses_kinds_it_: on a room of producers' objects, at least three distinct producer kinds are given one name
declared_before_the_run.T3_the_witness_rule_finds_checks_with_no: at least three checks survive the separation-and-repetition rule, read from the pages, with no program named in this source
declared_before_the_run.T4_the_witness_signature_separates_more_: on the unseen room, the signature separates strictly more different pairs than the written table
declared_before_the_run.T5_the_residual_is_named_not_hidden: the classes no witness separates are listed, with their per-class price, and the empty signature is one of them
declared_before_the_run.T6_storing_a_witness_buys_nothing_or_the: the witness set discovered on a second room of the same kinds is either identical (so the witness is derived, not learned) or the difference is listed
declared_before_the_run.T7_zero: zero model calls, zero stored parameters, zero network at run time

what_this_is_not: not a benchmark result: twenty objects, ten producers, one machine
not a type theory: a signature is what the machine's checks can still separate, and the classes they cannot separate are listed with their price
not a claim that a signature is a name: gzip -t+gunzip -t is not the word gzip
not a claim about rooms with no checker: an object no program can check has the empty signature and is reported as such
not learned: nothing is stored between runs, and the identical witness sets on two rooms are why
open_obligations: give a witness the argument its page declares and measure whether the residual falls below five classes
test transfer on a room whose producers were chosen after the rule was frozen, against the authored seven-kind list
a check that takes a second object (openssl verify, cmp, diff) is not a witness yet and its absence bounds this result

load_bearing_primary.why: OSWORLD_2_1_PARTIAL_GE_81_8 is the obligation a model-free action repertoire has to move: it is the one open row about DOING THINGS ON A COMPUTER, and its own failure axes (lost constraints, skipped verification) are what the goal check and the target-kind need are built to make mechanical. This round does not claim the row; it prices the mechanism that would have to carry it, on the only substrate available here (this sandbox's published pages).

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: REUSE was priced first and is the incumbent: the guide's own REFINES table is right on its own room (21 of 21 different pairs) and collapses 11 of 19 producer kinds on the next, so extending it is extending a guess. ADAPT: libmagic is the published answer and it is the same design -- a written table read against bytes. COMPOSE: the checks the machine declares are already there, but nothing selected among them, so the primitive synthesized here is the witness rule (separates, repeats, observes, is content-invariant per kind).

action_summary: Build a room out of objects their own producers made, measure what the guide's hand-written kind table says about them, then replace the table with witnesses selected from the checks the pages already declare, and ask whether a witness discovered once should be stored.

truth.what_is_real: 2319 declared checks -> 45 witnesses -> 4 distinctions that separate 155 of 189 different pairs on a room of 19 producer kinds, against 114 for the hand-written table; 5 residual classes priced in bits; the witness set identical on two rooms
truth.what_is_not: a type theory; a claim about checks that take arguments; a claim about GUIs; a benchmark result; any terminal credit

v22_prewrite_admission.proof_state_reachability: No truth obligation is discharged by this round. The mechanism is a typed repertoire and a path search over it; what it changes is the existence of a model-free action grammar on this substrate, not any open obligation.

tournament.decisive_question: Does the hand-written kind table still type the objects on a room of producers' objects, or is a derived witness set strictly better and honest about what it cannot separate?

benchmark_or_family_rank_authority: this sandbox's own programs; no benchmark output is borrowed and no answer is leaked
falsification_condition: two falsifiers, both live: (1) if argument-carrying witnesses do not reduce the residual below five classes, the ceiling is the objects, not the checks; (2) if the authored seven-kind list transfers to a room of kinds written after the rule as well as the derived set does, then authoring was never the cost and the difference measured here is decoration
measured_effect: the hand-written table: 114 of 189 different pairs and 11 of 19 producer kinds collapsed into plain. The authored scanner already in the tree: 161. The derived witness set: 45 witnesses behind 4 distinctions, 155 of 189, 5 residual classes priced in bits, with 16 declared 'checks' shown to be writes and 19 shown to be content tests rather than type tests
next_step: give a witness the argument its page declares (-f ARCHIVE, -in FILE) and measure whether the residual falls below five classes; then test transfer on a room of producers chosen after the rule was frozen
honest_limits: twenty objects and ten producers on one machine: a mechanism measurement, not a benchmark result

the rule reads only checks that take no argument of their own, so sqlite3, openssl verify and jq with a filter are absent by construction

honest_comparison.why_the_derived_set_is_still_the_route: the scanner this tree already had separates MORE different pairs than the derived witness set does, and this round does not beat it on that number: its validators were written by its author for kinds its author had met, and one of them (python) is a content test that this round's rule removes.
